description: Source code implementing shape caching and symbolic shape analysis for Torch JIT, including cache management, shape canonicalization, and shape retrieval functions.

classes.name: CanonicalizedSymbolicShape
classes.description: Represents a canonical form of a symbolic shape, with methods for initialization, conversion back to symbolic shape, hashing, and comparison.

methods.name: cannonicalizeVec
methods.description: Converts a vector of SSAInput into a vector of canonical arguments, optionally deep copying IValues.

methods.name: get_cache_key
methods.description: Generates a cache key tuple based on schema, arguments, and symbolic shape map.

methods.name: CanonicalizedSymbolicShape::init
methods.description: Initializes the canonical shape from a symbolic shape and shape symbol map.

methods.name: CanonicalizedSymbolicShape::toSymbolicShape
methods.description: Converts the canonical shape back to a symbolic shape, using an inverse shape symbol map.

methods.name: CanonicalizedSymbolicShape::hash
methods.description: Computes a hash value for the canonical shape.
